mapper.select: select report_id, reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason_code, description, status, case_id, handler_id, handle_result, handled_time, create_time from lf_report where report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: insert into lf_report ( reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason_code, description, status, create_time ) values ( #{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reasonCode}, #{description}, 'PENDING', sysdate() )
mapper.update: update lf_report set status = #{status}, case_id = #{caseId}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, handled_time = sysdate() where report_id = #{reportId} and status = 'PENDING'
